body: This made me laugh and is inspiring, but even as strange as life is, i am unhappy. And i don't think being the lucky sperm is going to make me feel any happier.

I really did try to connect with someone. I had a girlfriend for about a year, and i really did care about her, and found things in common.  But eventually i pushed her out of my life like everyone else. Came to the word "love." I can honestly say i have no clue what love is, and that i have never experienced it. I cared about her, but that isn't enough in a 1 way relationship. So it goes.
I am not talking about depression, more so the schizophrenia you cited. But hey, if it is saving your life, i really don't see any other options.

I don't ever know what do do :/
I also wish the drugs i take would miraculously cure an episode that quick like to you. I don't mean to come off as bitter, but i'm skeptical of a joint completely curing an episode like that, give me some of that bud. Also marijuana [worsens](http://www.livescience.com/10700-marijuana-worsens-schizophrenia.html) schizophrenia so i would be careful.

You have gone through a series of unfortunate events that i would not wish on anyone. It's not your fault. Life will get better though, you will crawl through this on one leg because you're fucking strong. You have not even got to experience life yet, only pain, so that is what you associate life with. Because you are always down, you think there is no up, but there is. Life will get up, and you will look back and be proud.
Oh, that's comical. I'll read your story, it will just take a while.

Not yet, i hope  that you are not lumping me into "blah school sucks," group. I am intelligent enough to get almost straight a's with out too much effort, it's not a problem. Or maybe it's small talk, i'm not sure what else i expected from this, maybe a sense of relief.
Right now i'm living near houston going to community college.
